questions.q: True or false? In three-two-three, our two midfielders should stand at the same height.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. One sits lower to link the defenders, and one higher to link the forwards.
choiceExplanations: At the same height, both link the same block, and the other block is cut off.
Right, it's false. One sits lower to link the defenders, and one higher to link the forwards.

questions.q: Put the midfield link-up in order, from first to last.
options: Lower midfielder passes to the higher one
Partner drops to the lower diagonal
questions.explain: Yes. They make two heights, connect, then swap jobs so each block keeps a link.
choiceExplanations: Yes. They make two heights, connect, then swap jobs so each block keeps a link.
The pass needs the higher partner in place first.
The left midfielder moves higher after the first diagonal pass.
The partner drops last, to replace the lower link the left midfielder left.

questions.q: Now the right midfielder links the back three. Drag the left midfielder to link the forwards.
questions.explain: Yes. Higher between the blocks, the left midfielder links the forwards while the partner stays low.
choiceExplanations: Both midfielders are low then, so nobody links the front three.
Up there you join the forwards, and the gap between blocks is left empty.
